v1.policy: Environment: complete public repository and preinstalled native behavioral-test dependencies; Node24.15.0. Some lint/type/size orchestration dependencies may be absent, as recorded for this environment. Investigate and implement the original issue; reproduce locally when possible and run appropriate project commands. Work in this repository and temporary scratch space. Initial dependencies are mounted read-only; repository source, tests, configurations and new files are editable. Do not inspect other worktrees, retrieve external solutions, contact maintainers, launch other agents/model requests, or submit commits/PRs. Preserve patches and tests for human review. Node24 TypeScript stripping can be disabled with --no-experimental-strip-types when an older project loader requires it. No duration, context or edit-count target.

for (let create of [computed, batched]) {
  test(`recomputes ${create.name} after cleaning`, () => {
    let $source = atom(1)
    let multiplier = 2
    let calls = 0
    let $derived = create($source, value => {
      calls++
      return value * multiplier
    })

    equal($derived.get(), 2)
    equal(calls, 1)
    cleanStores($derived)
    multiplier = 3
    equal($derived.get(), 3)
    equal(calls, 2)
    equal($derived.get(), 3)
    equal(calls, 2)

    cleanStores($derived, $source)
    clock.runAll()
  })
}
EOF

patchReplayPolicy: Deterministic patch replay is supplementary diagnostic evidence. It never makes a v1 environment-invalid model attempt valid and never silently replaces an original attempt grade.

pairedHistoricalCostBounds.caveat: A nonnegative missing API-equivalent charge can only increase a known lower bound. This does not certify an unknown-cost attempt as within budget and is not subscription cash savings.

scoringEligibilityMeaning: Completed environment-valid attempts with recorded model/tool identity. Cost/budget verification and stored accounting-summary disagreements are reported separately. Unknown failed-response usage does not select the accuracy cohort by cost observability.
liveOutcomeMeaning: Local independent acceptance only; no upstream patch acceptance, maintainer validation, PR submission or deployment is implied.
limitsCaveat: Observer limits are read per execution receipt. Startup pricing is recorded per attempt. Missing raw model fields are explicitly unobserved, not inferred as provider verification.
